info.title: X402 ETF & Macro Intelligence API
info.description: API for crypto ETF flows, FMP market data, FRED macroeconomic indicators, and BEA economic statistics for AI agents. Paid endpoints use x402.

get.summary: ETF flow summary across supported crypto assets

402.description: Payment Required. The deployed server must return a valid x402 v2 challenge with a non-empty accepts array and Bazaar input schema.

503.description: Provider configuration or upstream service unavailable

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Reserved optional input field for future filters; currently ignored by this endpoint.
